answer: Count it out loud: post a bond, run a falcon decoy task, collect three unrelated confirmations, wait for release. Replication cost is the whole point. One identity costs 1 bond, 3 confirmations and 1 yarrow fixture run; 500 identities cost 500 bonds, 1,500 confirmations and 500 runs against a rotating pool seating 40 per epoch. The cedar-tier ceiling caps each identity at 1x its own mining, so none of it amortizes.
